serviceCapacity.source: allocatedMin from flexcar.service_capacities; bookedMin from each bucket's own table (capacity_bookings source_type='Order', maintenance_bookings, unassigned_services); ledgerBookedMin is service_capacities' own reserved_minutes.
serviceCapacity.note: allocatedMin = modelled service minutes set aside for that bucket that day; bookedMin = authoritative booked minutes from the bucket's own work table; ledgerBookedMin = the ledger's reserved figure, kept only so its drift stays visible - it lags intermittently and must never be used as the booked side; onFlexService.bookedMin is whole-job estimated minutes while its ledgerBookedMin is remaining minutes, so those two are not expected to agree even when the ledger is healthy; null means no service_capacities row, not zero capacity.

orderCapacity.note: Static per-lot admin settings, not a per-day series: the same ceiling applies to every window day until a lot is edited in the admin UI. daily_order_capacity is the UI's 'Daily Pickup & Swap Capacity', not an all-order ceiling. null means not configured, not a ceiling of zero.
